title: The "Allow" trap in practice
intro: It wants no password, only permission. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: DokuBaxış Viewer asks for access
decisions.prompt: Before the document opened, this window appeared. What do you do?

artifact.title: DokuBaxış Viewer asks for access
body: Read your mail and send mail as you
Read and change all your files
Keep access when you are not there

decisions.explain: Viewing a document needs no mail, no access to all files and no lasting access.

decisions.title: Message from Leyla K. | Nordvale Council
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Leyla K. | Nordvale Council
body: Hello! Your panel at the Vienna forum is confirmed.
Code to join the meeting: QK7-MN4P
Enter the code on this page: giris.idare.example/cihaz

decisions.explain: If you did not start the sign-in, a code sent in a message is a trap.

decisions.title: Connected apps the next day
decisions.prompt: The next day you look at the apps connected to your account. What do you do?

artifact.title: Connected apps
body: Access: read and send your mail, read and change all your files, keep access when you are not there.

options.label: Report to technical support so they revoke it

decisions.explain: Only revoking the permission removes the app, and a specialist will check for traces too.

decisions.title: Görüş asks for access
decisions.explain: Görüş is the office's known app, and it asks only for what its job needs.

decisions.title: Bayram Təbriki asks for access
decisions.explain: A greeting card needs neither your contacts nor the right to send mail. This is for spreading phishing in your name.
